title: Nonconvex–concave optimization: arbitrary randomized algorithms and Moreau stationarity.

assumptions.scope: The complete stated domain. Constants remain uniform when the other variable block is fixed.
assumptions.description: The set $X$ is known, nonempty, closed, and convex. The set $Y$ is known, nonempty, compact, and convex, with $\operatorname{diam}(Y)\le D_y$. This setting uses $X=\mathbb R^{d_x}$.

assumptions.scope: The complete stated domain. Constants remain uniform when the other variable block is fixed.
assumptions.description: The function $f$ is jointly $\beta$-smooth on $X\times Y$. For every $x$, $f(x,\cdot)$ is concave. Convexity in the $x$ direction and a positive strong-concavity modulus are not required.

assumptions.scope: The complete stated domain. Constants remain uniform when the other variable block is fixed.
assumptions.description: The public feasible initial point $(x_0,y_0)$ satisfies $\Phi(x_0)-\inf_{x\in X}\Phi(x)\le\Delta<\infty$, where $\Phi(x)=\max_{y\in Y}f(x,y)$.

model.parameter_domain_description: $D_y$: nonnegative real; $\Delta$: positive real; $\beta$: positive real; $d_x$: positive integer; $d_y$: positive integer; $\varepsilon$: positive real. Derived quantities are defined in the parameter table. Each region states any additional accuracy and dimension conditions.
description_paragraphs: The set $X$ is known, nonempty, closed, and convex. The set $Y$ is known, nonempty, compact, and convex, with $\operatorname{diam}(Y)\le D_y$. This setting uses $X=\mathbb{R}^{d_x}$.
The function $f$ is jointly $\beta$-smooth on $X\times Y$. For every $x$, $f(x,\cdot)$ is concave. Convexity in the $x$ direction and a positive strong-concavity modulus are not required.
The public feasible initial point $(x_0,y_0)$ satisfies $\Phi(x_0)-\inf_{x\in X}\Phi(x)\le\Delta<\infty$, where $\Phi(x)=\max_{y\in Y}f(x,y)$.

description_paragraphs: Public inputs include block dimensions $d_x,d_y$ and $D_y$, $\Delta$, $\beta$, and $\varepsilon$, together with the stated initial points and feasible-set information. Analytic representations of hidden functions, operators, and matrices are not supplied.
Queries satisfy $(x,y)\in X\times Y$. The exact value and both gradient blocks form one bundled response.
Exact Euclidean projection onto the known set is allowed. Its calls are recorded separately and excluded from the primary query count.

output.allowed_postprocessing: The output may be any measurable postprocessing of the history, including an unqueried point, average, or convex combination. It must satisfy the stated domain and feasibility requirements; no additional function value or computable certificate is required.

metric.finiteness_conditions: Use the compact-domain, solution-existence, and smoothness assumptions in the model and the stated metric definition.
description_paragraphs: Let $\phi(x)=\Phi(x)+\iota_X(x)$, where $\iota_X$ equals $0$ on $X$ and $+\infty$ elsewhere; define $\phi_{1/(2\beta)}(c)=\min_u\{\phi(u)+\beta\|u-c\|_2^2\}$. The envelope is differentiable. Its gradient is the evaluation criterion, not a free oracle.

norms.definition: The Euclidean norm and inner product are $\|v\|_2=(\sum_jv_j^2)^{1/2}$ and $\langle u,v\rangle=\sum_j u_jv_j$. On the joint space use $\|(x,y)\|_2=(\|x\|_2^2+\|y\|_2^2)^{1/2}$.

regimes.predicate_text: Assume $\beta,\Delta,D_y,\varepsilon>0$, $A=\beta\Delta/\varepsilon^2$, and $B=\beta D_y/\varepsilon$; take $X=\mathbb R^{d_x}$ here. If $\varepsilon\ge\sqrt{8\beta\Delta/3}$, the separately stated zero-query algorithm is sharper.

evidence.statement_summary: AS upper and IS lower for fixed-cap randomized Moreau stationarity; full n,A,B phase diagram.
evidence.applicability_review: Only average dual concavity. Component value+joint gradient at chosen index. Known compact Y, primal Euclidean unconstrained, no component affine-gradient bound. Success2/3; AS includes IS, so lower transfer is class inclusion. Dimension supremum may require exponentially large d. No claim about a fixed prescribed Y. Not fresh samples.

evidence.applicability_review: Source definition is first good queried iterate, not automatically a fixed returned output for a lower bound. Extra final query can embed arbitrary returned point with +1 call. Domains known X closed, Y compact; value+joint gradient; lower dimension supremum. Source version Oct22 predates the old atlas Oct31 cutoff; its omission is not explained by the cutoff.
